title: Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 46 (Welfare) - Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (selected sections)
deposited: Arizona cash assistance (TANF): title 46 definitions (46-101), the amount of assistance (46-207, 46-207.01), eligibility (46-292), the 12-month time limit and hardship extension (46-294), unwed minor parents (46-296), diversion (46-298) and sanctions (46-300).
